title: Security Notes When Working on a Software Development Project
description: “Security is everyone’s responsibility.” – A familiar saying, but in the reality of a project, it is the thing most often forgotten.
flags: Title: 'Những lưu ý về bảo mật khi tham gia phát triển dự án phần mềm' rendered as 'Security Notes When Working on a Software Development Project' ('tham gia phát triển' = taking part in developing).
